roles.title: Sr. Product Manager, Lab Execution CGP (Oncology)

bullets: Own the product strategy and roadmap for Lab Execution software in our CGP labs spanning across extraction, library prep, sequencing, and assay QC.
Translate Oncology business goals (launch timelines, volume growth, turnaround time, and COGS) into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap.
Drive a platform mindset: reusable, configurable capabilities that serve multiple assays and labs instead of one-off builds.
Champion AI-forward products that reduce manual touchpoints, surface exceptions early, and make lab operators more effective.

roles.title: Associate Director / Director of Product Management, Signatera Hematologic Oncology (Heme)

bullets: Develop and execute the Signatera product roadmap for hematologic malignancies, beginning with multiple myeloma and lymphomas (for example, DLBCL, follicular, mantle cell, and…
Lead market entry planning for Signatera in heme as a laboratory developed test (LDT), including clinical validation requirements, CLIA and state requirements, market…
Define product requirements for blood-based malignancies with R&D, Lab Operations, and Software Engineering, including assay, sample type, workflow, and reporting needs.
Lead product support for clinical trials using Signatera in heme, including IUO use in studies with pharma and academic partners, and the path toward IVD and regulated use.
Partner with Regulatory, Clinical, and Business Development on trial start-up, study requirements, and pharma and companion diagnostic opportunities.
